summary: Add deterministic exhaustive repository-object inventory and full-range semantic-processing coverage controls.
reason: This changes the evidence required for an exhaustive repository-wide coverage claim. The new manifest pins a Git commit and inventories every tracked tree entry; the coverage checker requires matching object identity, assigned semantic method, COMPLETE semantic status, and complete line/byte/object ranges. Search, sampling, snippets, exclusions, and inaccessible entries cannot satisfy an exhaustive claim. Structural Optimization is added because the change introduces a new manifest/ledger artifact pair and deterministic controls whose burden and separation require explicit review.
